vibe: Command-center focus. High-visibility 'Tactical' look. Built for consistency and high-performance tracking.

rules.headings: MUST use Strong Condensed Sans (900 weight) with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for a 'heavy-weight' feel.
rules.labels: MUST be Uppercase, Tiny (text-xs), Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
rules.line_height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.

rules: Default to Dark Mode for the tactical command-center feel.
Tactical Minimalism: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.
Use high-saturation accent blocks (Volt Blue/Electric Blaze) for progress bars and CTA buttons.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
No pure #808080. Tint neutrals with blue.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have border-r border-b border-border/40.
visual_enhancers.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, NO shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brightens.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid on main dashboard to prevent visual refraction of data. Use flat solid surfaces for maximum clarity. Can be used ONLY for sticky top navigation.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use strict geometric shapes. No noise, just clean data clarity.

layouts.general: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy inside widgets (p-6, p-8). Containers with border MUST have internal padding to prevent text collision.

screens.dashboard: Bento layout. Top-left: North Star Metric (Current active streak). Right: Habit consistency Heatmap (Recharts). Bottom: Today's Habits list with inline complete toggle.
screens.leaderboard: Tactical rankings view. Top 3 prominently displayed with large avatars and neon rank numbers. Table layout below with hover states for rows.
screens.history: Calendar visualization (heatmap) or large scannable log.

components.navigation: Left sidebar (collapsible) for desktop. Hamburger for mobile. Sidebar MUST have solid background.
components.habit_list: List format. DO NOT overuse card component. Use flat, rectangular rows with 1px bottom border. Hover state should highlight the row with a 1px primary color left border.
components.toggle_checkbox: Use Shadcn Checkbox. Scale animation on check. Primary color fill when checked.
components.charts: Use Recharts/Shadcn Charts for heatmap and weekly progress. Minimalist tooltips. Solid color fills (primary/accent), no chaotic gradients.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input. Left-aligned labels.

rules: Staggered entrance animations for habit lists.
Satisfying scale-bounce when a habit is marked complete.
DO NOT use transition: all. Target specific properties (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease).

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for high-end app feel.

rules: Normal text: Min 4.5:1 contrast. Large text: Min 3:1.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='habit-toggle-button').
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT drop shadows.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
NEVER use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
action_items: Install required fonts: Barlow Condensed & DM Sans.
Setup the routes: Dashboard, History, Leaderboard, Auth.
Mock API calls in the frontend if backend is unlinked, to ensure the UI is fully visible.
Apply the color palette to index.css overwriting defaults.
Follow the .js file extensions instead of .tsx.
